verdict.rationale: Snowflake's zero-copy cloning (clone inherits privileges, no data duplication) and RBAC/role isolation provide the underlying mechanisms to spin up an isolated copy of data for testing without touching production, and warehouses can be independently sized/scaled for a test workload. However, there is no first-party documentation framing this as an 'AI-native sandbox' or describing a dedicated test/dev environment workflow tied to AI agent development. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/dev-environment documentation, AI-agent-specific sandbox guidance, and any hands-on/independent confirmation that cloning is used this way in practice.
